skeleton.heading: # Meeting your persona (title, frontmatter and abstract)
skeleton.purpose: Names the outcome so a reader arriving from the install page knows this is the page that finishes what setup started.
must_cover: Frontmatter with all six keys the linter requires (scripts/lint_wiki.py:45): title 'Meeting your persona', a status from the accepted set at scripts/lint_wiki.py:56 (`scoped` matches the sibling install page, wiki/installing.md:3), type: how-to, last_reviewed, related, sources.

Every `related` entry must resolve from wiki/ or the linter errors (scripts/lint_wiki.py:290-297). Candidates that exist today: first-run.md, installing.md, features/personas.md, features/second-brain.md, features/voice.md.
